paper_title: LaSQuE Improved Zero-Shot Classification from Explanations Through   Quantifier Modeling and Curriculum Learning

Length 5 the bar is approximately 0.38; at 10 it is about 0.41; at 15 it is about 0.41; at 20 it is around 0.36; at 25 it is near 0.32; at 30 it is near 0.31 (the shortest); and at 35 it is about 0.35.
